properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 899199 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party: REGENCY ARTISTIC METAL REFINISHING
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 899199
Incident Time: 2009-03-05 19:30:00
Nearest City: Holiday, FL
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: VARIOUS ACIDS
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: REGENCY ARTISTIC METAL REFINISHING
Skytruth Analysis
AFTER RECEIVING A 911 CALL, THE PASCO COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT REPONDED TO THE REGENCY ARTISTIC METAL REFINISHING SHOP, AND FOUND THE RESPONSIBLE PARTY (OWNER) UNCONSCIOUS. FIRE FIGHTERS ENTERED THE BUILDING AND RESCUED WILLIAM SUTTON. THE FIRE FIGHTERS WERE ALMOST OVERCOME BY UNKNOWN CHEMICAL FUMES INSIDE THE FACILITY. THE PASCO COUNTY HAZMAT TEAM RESPONDED TO THE SITE, AND ENTERED THE FACILITY IN PROPER PPE, AND DISCOVERED UNMARKED OPEN 5-GAL PAILS OF UNKNOWN LIQUIDS AND NUMEROUS 55-GAL DRUMS. THE HAZMAT TEAMS BELIEVES THAT THE FACILITY HAS ACIDS AND CYANIDES ONSITE. FDEP RESPONDED TO THE PLATING SHOP, AND ASSISTED THE COUNTY. THE FACILITY IS CURRENTLY LOCKED, AND THE POWER HAS BEEN CUT OFF. THE OWNER OF THE FACILITY IS IN VERY SERIOUS CONDITION AT A LOCAL HOSPITAL. AIR MONITORING OUTSIDE THE BUILDING WAS NEGATIVE FOR HYDROGEN CYANIDE.

AS OF DECEMBER 4, 2008 CONTRACTORS WORKING IN ASSOCIATION WITH AISIN HAVE BEEN DISPATCHED TO THE SITE AND ACTIVE RECOVERY OF THE PRODUCT AND WATER FROM THE LAUREL RIVER IS BEING CONDUCTED. KENTUCKY DEP IS ALSO ON-SCENE AND PARTICIPATED IN A MEETING ON SITE AT THE AISIN FACILITY DECEMBER 4 AT 10:00AM.
